body_character_definition: HTML tags removed, entities decoded, whitespace runs collapsed; full bodies not retained

reported_total_score_semantics: site displayed number preserved; weighting not inferred
source_dates_available: not extracted; no inference from article ID or list position

keyword matches do not determine sentiment, prevalence, service existence or option support
no shop/person identity resolution; historical terms may differ
review links saved, not individually access-checked
